value.answer: There isn't one number. It depends on the lender and on whether your mortgage is insured (under 20% down) or uninsured. The lowest insured 5-year fixed I can see is 4.34%. Uninsured is a bit higher, around 4.44%, though the sources don't agree exactly on that. Among the big banks, one is at 4.54% and Scotiabank is at 4.74%. Fixed rates have been climbing since early September, so they're moving up.
